title: Taskflow Agent finds unauthorized group assignment in Umbraco CMS
summary: The bulk user-group assignment endpoint checked permission to modify target users but omitted authorization for the groups being assigned, allowing an authenticated non-admin API user to add a user to the Administrators group.
ai_role: GHSL credits its Taskflow Agent with finding the issue and says Jaroslav Lobačevski manually verified it. GHSL reports the submission collided with another reporter; this entry records AI-assisted identification and does not claim first discovery.
classification_note: The GHSL report and matching vendor GHSA document the issue and fix; neither source cited here claims exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: GHSL says Umbraco CMS 16.5.1 and 17.2.2 fixed the flaw on 2026-03-10. GHSL reports its submission was a collision with another reporter acknowledged 2026-02-26; attribution is to AI-assisted discovery, not priority.

impacts.conditions: An authenticated Umbraco backoffice user has permission to manage users and modifies group membership in affected versions; insufficient authorization can permit assigning higher roles.
impacts.exploitation: Not established by the cited CNA description; no independent exploitation assessment made.
